name: Movie Hub HQ Drive
release_notes: Removed progress bar feature and added configurable maintenance end-time countdown (days, hours, minutes, seconds) with quick presets, live admin preview, and auto-refresh
In-feed middle manual ad code configuration in Admin Panel with responsive injection between episode buttons
Migrated public page URLs from view.php?slug=ep-xxx to clean /p/{slug} structure globally across page generator, share sheets, and frontend
Seamless 301 redirection for legacy links and backwards-compatible bi-directional slug lookup
Packaged atomic v-5.1.0 cPanel release bundle with synchronized SHA256 checksum for remote one-click updater
